sonnet.problem: The statement defines "this turn of events" as "King Rehoboam refusing to listen to the people." The BSB (1 Kings 12:15) says only "So the king did not listen to the people, and indeed this turn of events was from the LORD" and does not say what the phrase covers. The statement also bundles two claims: that it was from the LORD, and that it was to fulfill the word spoken to Jeroboam through Ahijah.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect. ... A true or false statement tests one claim.
